ns2:section.sectionText: To be added to the waitlist for this course, please send an email to dance-waitlist@uiuc.edu no sooner than one week prior to the start of classes. The subject line must read DANC 100-D Waitlist, and the body of the email must contain your name and uin. You will receive an auto-reply when you have been successfully added to the waitlist. If you do not receive the auto-reply, you have not been added to the waitlist. Please note that this is an unmonitored email account, and questions sent to the address will not be answered. You will receive instructions on how to register via email if/when a seat opens up.
